description: Strict-2D GW for monolayer WSe2 (CP2K GTH + SIAB matched basis), direct_mixed_fourier positive-Gram Coulomb.

in_plane_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: WSe2 monolayer needs at least a 12x12 in-plane mesh for the q->0 head.
in_plane_kgrid.rationale: TMD monolayers have a strong q-dependence near Gamma, so a coarse mesh biases the head.

vacuum.per_system_override_rule: Use at least 20 Angstrom vacuum for the WSe2 slab.
vacuum.rationale: The WSe2 slab needs enough vacuum that the 2D Ewald images do not overlap.

ewald_precision.per_system_override_rule: Keep the Ewald precision tight and prefer the direct_mixed_fourier positive-Gram Coulomb output.
ewald_precision.rationale: The strict-2D full-Ewald auxiliary Coulomb can be strongly indefinite; the direct_mixed_fourier output is the positive-Gram construction that is safe. Never clip eigenvalues.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Use a dense frequency grid for the TMD screening.
nfreq.rationale: TMD screening has weight at higher frequencies.

nbands.per_system_override_rule: Set nbands equal to nbasis for the SIAB basis.
nbands.rationale: An incomplete state space corrupts EXX/GW.
